correctness.rationale: For each integer n>=1, Baker--Teragaito arXiv:2510.07618v1 define beta_n as a positive 4-braid with (1,2,3)^4 (12 generators), the 13-generator fixed tail, and 2^(2n) (2n generators): length 2n+25. Its closure is a knot of genus n+11 and braid index exactly 4 (Theorem 1.2 and Lemma 3.1). Every diagram D satisfies g(K)<=(c_D-s_D+1)/2, and Yamada gives s_D>=b(K), so c_D>=2g+b-1=2n+25. The displayed braid gives the matching upper bound. Baker--Teragaito prove N=S^3\(K_0 union c) hyperbolic and K_n complements arise by nontrivial (-1/n) filling on c, with each filled complement hyperbolic (Lemma 3.2). Standard strict volume-decrease under hyperbolic filling yields 0<vol(K_n)<vol(N), and division by c(K_n)=2n+25 gives a squeeze to zero. No numerical finite sample is used as an infinite proof. Boundaries: n=0 excluded, and no claim of exact volume or monotonicity.
